meta.name: nano-banana-prompting
meta.description: This skill should be used when crafting prompts for Nano Banana Pro (Gemini image generation). Use when users want help writing image generation prompts, need guidance on prompt structure, or want to optimize their prompts for better results.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出能生成理想图像的提示词
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为 Gemini 图像模型编写有效提示词
copy.tagline_en: Craft prompts that generate ideal images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write effective prompts for Gemini image models

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会通过提问了解你的意图，然后根据你的回答选择合适的提示词格式，帮你写出用于 Nano Banana Pro 图像生成的有效提示词，并推荐生成图像。
howto.when: 当用户请求帮助撰写图像生成提示词、指导提示词结构或优化提示词以获得更好结果时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个生成日落海滩照片的提示词。
say.note: Claude 会询问输出类型、主体等细节。

say.text: 我需要一个结构化的提示词，生成一张带有文字的杂志封面。
say.note: Claude 会采用物理对象框定技术。

say.text: 优化这句提示词：'一只猫在草地上'，让它更专业。
say.note: Claude 会补充技术细节和负向提示词。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude guide you through a structured process to craft effective prompts for Nano Banana Pro image generation by clarifying intent and applying proven techniques, then suggests generating the image.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask for help writing image generation prompts, need guidance on prompt structure, or want to optimize prompts for better results.

say_en.text: Help me write a prompt for a sunset beach photo.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about output type, subject, etc.

say_en.text: I need a structured prompt for a magazine cover with text.
say_en.note: Claude will use Physical Object Framing technique.

say_en.text: Optimize this prompt: 'a cat on grass' to be more professional.
say_en.note: Claude will add technical specs and negative prompts.
